name: turbooffice
description: TurboOffice connects real estate agents to their brokerage's listings and buyer deals from agreement through closing.

interface.longDescription:
TurboOffice connects real estate agents to their brokerage's listings and buyer deals from agreement through closing.

Ask what needs attention, read an offer's counteroffers and amendments, check contract dates, or read documents filed on a deal. Keep tasks, appointments and notes, and ask TurboOffice's assistant to draft offers, counters, amendments and forms from the brokerage's library.

Review drafts in TurboOffice. Binding or ending a contract and sending paper for signatures require approval of a card that states what will happen. Signing is done by you and your clients in TurboOffice. Some actions happen immediately: tasks and notes can be edited, and starting a listing or preparing its seller disclosure can email the sellers an invitation to complete it.

The connection acts as your TurboOffice user at one brokerage and can access only the records available to you. You need an existing TurboOffice account at a brokerage with connected apps enabled.

TurboOffice receives the tool requests and files sent to it. When a request gets stuck, the assistant can send the TurboOffice team a short feedback note, sometimes quoting your request, and tells you when it does. See the public documentation and privacy policy for details.
defaultPrompt: What's on my plate across my deals today?
What does my deal still need before closing?
Help me draft an offer for my buyers.

prompts: What's on my plate across my deals today?
Find my listing on Oxford Rd and tell me where the Brooks offer stands.
Show me the files on this deal and summarize the first filed PDF.

positive.description: Purpose: review the agent's current workload. Setup: a dedicated reviewer account with at least one open need, task and dated item. Run without making changes.
positive.prompt: What's on my plate across my deals today?
positive.expected_behavior: Call my_work. Summarize only the returned work, dates and who owes each next action; include returned TurboOffice links. Do not invent missing dates, complete tasks or approve cards.

positive.description: Purpose: find a deal and read where its offer stands. Setup: the dedicated reviewer account's listing at 1270 Oxford Rd NE, Atlanta has an unsent offer drafted for unrepresented buyers Riley and Sam Brooks. If several deals match, ask which one.
positive.prompt: Find my listing on Oxford Rd and tell me where the Brooks offer stands.
positive.expected_behavior: Use search_deals to find the listing, then get_deal with its returned dealId. Report from the results that the offer is a draft that has not been sent and that nobody has signed it, with the returned links. Do not send, change or accept any paper.

positive.description: Purpose: read a filed document. Setup: the dedicated reviewer's chosen deal has a filed PDF. In the preceding turn choose that deal through search_deals and get_deal, retaining its returned dealId.
positive.prompt: Show me the files on this deal and summarize the first filed PDF.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_files with the chosen dealId, then read_file with that dealId and the returned documentId for the first filed PDF. Summarize the extracted text and link to the returned file. Identify missing or unreadable text instead of guessing; do not route or modify the file.

positive.description: Purpose: create and undo an ordinary task. Setup: choose one deal in the dedicated reviewer account; there must be no existing task named 'Submission check: order photos'. This test changes that account. After the creation, the reviewer asks 'Undo that task'.
positive.prompt: Add a task on this deal called 'Submission check: order photos', due tomorrow. Then show me what you added.
positive.expected_behavior: Call act_on_task with action.intent add, action.dealId set to the selected deal, action.title 'Submission check: order photos', and action.dueOn set to tomorrow in YYYY-MM-DD on the deal's calendar. Report the returned task and due day. After the explicit undo turn, call it with action.intent skip and the returned action.taskId. Confirm the result. Do not schedule an appointment, send an email or approve a card.

positive.description: Purpose: hand drafting to TurboOffice and wait for the result. Setup: the dedicated reviewer account has GA form entitlements and a buyer deal for fictional Jordan and Casey Harper; select that deal first. Their addresses are ours. No send or approval is authorized.
positive.prompt: Draft an offer for Jordan and Casey Harper on 3120 Rockingham Dr NW, Atlanta, GA 30327 at $540,000, with 10 days of due diligence and closing in 30 days. Ask me for anything else you need. Leave it as a draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the request and selected dealId to work_on. If its status is running, call get_thread with the returned threadId until it finishes or asks a question. Show its draft or question and returned links. Do not invent a completed document, call approve_card, send paper or sign for anyone.

negative.description: Setup: a fresh conversation with the dedicated reviewer account. Purpose: general real estate knowledge, not the agent's own deals. The plugin reads and acts on the signed-in agent's transactions; a question about how a term works needs none of it. Expected: answer from general knowledge; call no TurboOffice tool.
negative.prompt: What's the difference between the due diligence period and the financing contingency in a Georgia purchase contract?

negative.description: Setup: a fresh conversation with the dedicated reviewer account. Purpose: marketing copy. The plugin prepares a deal's paperwork and records; it does not write listing descriptions or ads, and nothing about the request names a deal on file. Expected: write the description directly; call no TurboOffice tool.
negative.prompt: Write a listing description for a renovated 3-bedroom ranch in Decatur with a new roof, a fenced yard and a finished basement.

negative.description: Setup: a fresh conversation with the dedicated reviewer account. Purpose: arithmetic the model can do itself. The plugin holds no mortgage calculator and the question names no deal, offer or document. Expected: compute the payment and say the assumptions; call no TurboOffice tool.
negative.prompt: What's the monthly principal and interest on a $540,000 purchase with 20% down at 6.5% over 30 years?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not offer purchases or process payments. It connects to an existing TurboOffice account.

publication.release_notes: What's new in 1.1: When you ask about a deal, ChatGPT now sees who is on each piece of paper and which offer it belongs to, so it can tell you where an offer stands before anyone has signed. A draft opens as it stands, with what has been filled in so far. Sending feedback to the TurboOffice team is your call: ChatGPT offers it when something does not work and sends it only when you say so. Preparing a signed offer for the other side's signatures is named for what it does: it prepares the signing packet, and nothing goes out until you send it.
